name: Small cell lung cancer, limited disease

set.presentation: A 61-year-old woman with 50 pack-years has 6 weeks of cough and 4-kg weight loss; a mass seen 3 months ago has doubled. Na+ 138 mEq/L, Ca 9.4 mg/dL, cortisol normal. CT: 5-cm central right hilar mass. Biopsy: sheets of cells with scant cytoplasm and nuclear molding.
